fields.title: BCCAR registry search-result record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Each successful record is one matched business entity from BCCAR's public search, with upstream's own field names passed through verbatim.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The query label (name, registration number, certificate number, or entity type) that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: S1-public-business-search (a matched entity), or none (error record).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed searches -- not_found (search matched nothing) or blocked_or_transient (network issue).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

reg_number.title: Registration number
reg_number.description: BCCAR's official public registration number for the entity.

foreign_name.title: Foreign character name
foreign_name.description: Name in a non-Latin script, where on file (empty on nearly every record).

state.title: Status
state.description: Current register status, e.g. "Active", "Struck off", "Dissolved", "Pending Strike off".

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns for matched entities and error rows.
